Package ai.local.nalbbun.config

Class JdbcMemoryDataSourceConfig

java.lang.Object
ai.local.nalbbun.config.JdbcMemoryDataSourceConfig
@Configuration @ConditionalOnMissingBean(javax.sql.DataSource.class) @ConditionalOnExpression("\'${app.memory.store:in-memory}\' == \'jdbc\' || (\'${app.rag.enabled:false}\' == \'true\' && \'${app.rag.vector-store:pgvector}\' == \'pgvector\')") public class JdbcMemoryDataSourceConfig extends Object
